# Remove all green blocks at columns 33, 39, 45, 51 (both rows 27 and 33)
# These are the ones that don't have purple targets above them

# Click on green blocks at row 27, columns 33, 39, 45
# Click on green blocks at row 33, columns 33, 39, 45, 51

    {'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 27, 'col': 45},  # Remove (27, 45)

]
